slides.headline: Your Unspent Money Finances Starbucks
slides.subheadline: The promise: **convenient, rewarding payments**. The mechanism: customer prepayments.

designSystem.typography: Condensed editorial headlines; readable sans-serif bodies; monospace kickers and tabular numerals. Bold anchors render as actual bold.
designSystem.geometry: 64px safe margins, 0px corners, 1px hairlines, square indicators. No shadows, pills, progress bars or thick accent borders.
designSystem.production: Apply throughout. Word budgets cover visible editorial copy, not blueprint instructions. Render citation markers as discreet linked references.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 650" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Occupy 50% of the canvas with a monumental stored-value-card specimen. Construct a sharp rectangular surface at x=126 y=100 width=700 height=420; separate its lower edge into three offset architectural strata, suggesting a forensic section through prepaid value. One vermilion magnetic-stripe hairline crosses the upper third. Add sparse measurement ticks and four square registration marks, never invented coordinates. Above: square-dot monospace kicker, 64px condensed headline, 1px divider. Below: clean publication and interest ledger. No clipart, arrows, conduits, hatching or simulated text.

slides.headline: Convenience Makes Prepayment Feel Harmless
slides.subheadline: Card and value never expire. Cash access differs.

items.title: THE PROMISE
items.body: **No activation, service, dormancy or inactivity fees**.

items.title: THE LIMIT
items.body: Cash redemption restricted; **legal exceptions still apply**.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Place a dominant 580×310 surface panel at x=0 y=20 and a secondary 330×220 paper panel at x=622 y=170. Give each a 1px hairline perimeter and square corners. Behind them, expose the outline of a single oversized stored-value card, interrupted by the panels as though its terms are being dissected. One magnetic-stripe rule and sparse perimeter measurement ticks establish the financial specimen. Set the promise large in the hero panel; isolate the cash restriction in the lower ledger. No additional SVG text, decorative text lines, arrows or shadows.

slides.headline: The Headline Float Mixes Obligations
slides.subheadline: The $1,840.6 million current line also mixes obligations.

items.title: YEAR-END BALANCE
items.body: **Cards plus loyalty**, not exclusively customer cash.
items.label: Million dollars

items.title: ANNUAL DEFERRALS
items.body: **Activations, reloads and Stars** aren't all cash.
items.label: Million dollars / fiscal 2025

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 448 370" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Use a 40/60 split: architectural section left, two tightly edited ledger entries right. Build two overlapping rectangular liability slabs at x=38 y=54 width=292 height=184 and x=110 y=132 width=292 height=184. Separate their shared edge with a vermilion hairline to expose mixed accounting categories. Shapes are explicitly conceptual, not proportional amounts or an additive comparison. A single vertical 1px divider separates illustration and typography. Keep exact figures unabridged in tabular type; put million-dollar units directly beneath. No cash-reserve implication, proportional bars or invented component shares.

slides.headline: Never Expires. Still Becomes Revenue.

items.title: ESTIMATE NONREDEMPTION
items.body: Historical patterns estimate **balances unlikely to redeem**.

items.title: RECOGNIZE PROPORTIONATELY
items.body: **Recognize proportionately** as other card balances redeem.

items.title: PRESERVE DISTINCTIONS
items.body: Recognition **doesn't expire balances**; unclaimed-property remittances matter.​

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 480" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Draw one continuous 1px vertical examination spine at x=70 from y=34 to y=442, with square markers at y=78, 240 and 402. Align the three findings at x=112. Behind the far-right margin, show three detached rectangular cross-sections of the same stored-value card: intact outline, exposed accounting layer, intact contractual perimeter. Only the middle accounting layer receives accent color; the final perimeter remains unbroken. Markers are reading anchors, not dated events. No connecting arrows, process pipes, fake transaction marks or implied expiration.

slides.headline: Spending Access Isn't Cash Access
slides.subheadline: Washington Consumer Protection Coalition challenged app reloads.

items.title: STARBUCKS RESPONDS
items.body: **Spend remainder**, then pay difference cash in-store.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Arrange two horizontal evidence tracks at y=106 and y=304, separated by generous negative space rather than cards. The complaint track contains a stored-value-card outline with an open dashed boundary, signifying a contested restriction. The response track terminates at a solid square beside a card perimeter with an open corner, signifying the stated in-store spending option—not cash withdrawal. Use 1px rules without arrowheads; place the date in a sharp rectangular plate. Keep both parties equally legible. No locked-padlock icon, quantified captivity graphic or suggestion that the complaint established liability.

slides.headline: Starbucks Books Revenue From Nonredemption
slides.subheadline: Breakage is revenue, not separately audited profit.

items.title: COMPANY OPERATED
items.body: **$200.4 million** recognized as company-operated store revenue.

items.title: LICENSED STORES
items.body: **$22.0 million** recognized as licensed store revenue.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 440" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Set $222.4 in 110px accent-colored tabular numerals, with its million-dollar and fiscal-year label immediately below. Under the numeral, draw a single straight-edged 800px accounting beam divided into adjacent segments: 720.86px for company-operated revenue and 79.14px for licensed revenue, calculated from 200.4 and 22.0. Use ink and accent outlines with surface fill, square ends and no progress-track background. Position the two exact component figures beneath their respective sections. A 1px dimension bracket spans the total. This is a revenue composition, never a profit or cash-reserve graphic.

slides.headline: Retail Float, Not A Bank
slides.subheadline: Customer prepayments finance Starbucks without paying customers interest.

items.title: FINANCING ADVANTAGE
items.body: Cash arrives first; **fulfillment still costs Starbucks**.​

items.title: LEGAL REALITY
items.body: **No FDIC insurance** doesn't erase consumer-protection law.

Set the two findings as open typography separated by one 1px horizontal ledger rule, not repeated cards. No bank-building silhouette, insurance shield, arrows or decorative numeric labels.
